final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS ch, f.feerate AS fr FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), g AS (SELECT ch, AVG(fr) AS ga FROM m GROUP BY ch), ov AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.ga AS ga, ov.oa AS oa FROM g JOIN ov ON ov.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ga > ov.oa) SELECT AVG(ga) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(ga - oa) AS avg_diff FROM k
